# Redacted Codex subagent activity fixtures

These five fixtures retain structural evidence from the user-supplied October 7, 2026 child sessions listed in `specs/2026-10-08-codex-subagent-activity/context.md`. The initial inherited prefix preserves its native boundary ordinal. After that prefix, irrelevant tool/reasoning/bookkeeping rows are omitted and remaining physical ordinals are reassigned contiguously. Native task IDs, task ordering, routing, adjacent trigger metadata, timestamps and terminal kinds are preserved. All transcript prose is replaced with redacted placeholders; encrypted payload bytes are replaced with a public test sentinel. These are parser fixtures, not complete transcripts or exact provider-store dumps.

Expected child native `response_item` assistant reply counts are `docs-and-device:4`, `cursor-fix:8`, `window-fix:7`, `navigation-audit:1` and `scroll-audit:1`. This counts `payload.type:"message"` and `payload.role:"assistant"`; commentary/status `event_msg.agent_message` rows omitted from these structural fixtures still survive in the complete ordinary projection and actual activity envelope. Exact original ordinals and normalized-array parity are additionally checked against the five read-only live rollout carriers during implementation validation.
